name: Hosaka Eiji
source:
Chikako's uncle. He runs the company Chikako happens to work at. He once tried to rape his niece but she was rescued by her brother Asuma.

[spoiler]The company he owns is a front for a sex slave trade. He hired his niece in order to have a second chance at raping her.[/spoiler]
